name: Personal Watch
displayDescription:
Find out when daytime/nighttime begins!

* Appears at the top of the screen!

name: Death Waypoint
displayDescription:
This automatically creates a waypoint to your location of death.
(If you already have max capable waypoints when you die, the waypoint will not be created)

name: Octuple Waypoints
displayDescription: 4 waypoints just isn't enough? With EIGHT waypoints, you're open to more spots to mark off. Have a cool base and you don't want to forget its location? Mark it off.
